notes.title: Mainu demo coming soon to macOS!
notes.notes: Apologize to Mac users, I am working diligently on a Mac build and it should be coming soon. There were some issues with the Mac build and I will update you all when it is ready. Thanks and sorry again.

notes.title: Deck Builder Update – Customize Your Team of Mainus!
notes.notes:
🎉 Thank you for checking out the Mainu demo! I just added one of our most requested features:

🧩 **Deck Builder Unlocked**  
You can now build your own custom deck of up to 26 Mainus! Mix and match your favorites and create the ultimate strategy to defeat bosses.

🧪 This gives you more room to experiment with builds and test how different Mainus perform.

💬 We'd love to hear what builds you're trying out! Join the Discord and share your strategies with the community. https://discord.gg/CEGhC2uT

👀 Stay tuned for more updates as we continue development toward the full version!
